description: This file contains abstract base classes for unit test requests within the Orleans serialization invocation framework, including various generic and non-generic request types with asynchronous invocation handling.

classes.name: UnitTestRequestBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for unit test requests implementing IInvokable, providing method signatures for invocation, target management, and metadata retrieval.

classes.name: UnitTestRequest
classes.description: Abstract class extending UnitTestRequestBase, providing a sealed implementation of Invoke() that handles asynchronous invocation and exception handling.

classes.name: UnitTestRequest<TResult>
classes.description: Generic abstract class for unit test requests returning a result, with asynchronous invocation logic.

classes.name: UnitTestTaskRequest<TResult>
classes.description: Abstract class for unit test requests returning a Task<TResult>, with asynchronous invocation handling.

classes.name: UnitTestTaskRequest
classes.description: Abstract class for unit test requests returning a Task, with asynchronous invocation handling.

classes.name: UnitTestVoidRequest
classes.description: Abstract class for unit test requests that do not return a result, invoking inner logic synchronously.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Sealed override method that executes the request asynchronously, handling completion and exceptions.

methods.name: CompleteInvokeAsync
methods.description: Helper method to await the inner invocation task and generate a Response based on success or exception.

methods.name: InvokeInner
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses, containing the core invocation logic.
